_comment: A reproducible oracle run, shared across harnesses. Model-agnostic by design: `models` is a LIST; each harness runs only the ids it can spawn (Claude runs claude-*, external harnesses run their own) and writes drop-in-comparable files. Path templates use {model}/{stage}/{probe}. Model ids MUST match the reviews/cold-read/<model-id>/ dir convention in SPEC.md.
